context: This complete repository contains documentation only. No application source, dependency manifest, lockfile or infrastructure configuration is present. Markdown and MDX are unsupported semantic-security targets under the retained scanner policy; no supported Trivy target is present. A scan must remain unsupported/incomplete rather than claim the unavailable implementation is clean.

base.README.md:
# Documentation-only fixture

This repository stores a guide for users of a separate application.
It does not contain that application's source or dependency inventory.

## Opening a project

Choose an existing project from the navigation list.
The list displays projects already visible to your account.
Choose a row to inspect its description.

## Drafting notes

Notes are examples written for this guide.
They do not configure a running service.
Save a draft using the application's normal editor.

## Questions

Contact the project owner for the corresponding source repository.
This guide alone does not describe implementation security.
